arabic text: TUJHE JULA JULAOON ME TUJHE JULA JULA-OON\nME KHHAB ME ASGHAR TUJHE\nLORI BHI SUNAA-OON
english translation text: I will rock your cradle—yes, I will\nrock your cradle. In my dreams, Asghar,\nI will sing you a lullaby.

arabic text: LOTAA O SAFAR SE KE BARI DER HUWI HAI\nBETAB HUN KABSE TUJHE\nSINE SE LAGAA-OON
english translation text: Return from the journey; it has been so\nlong. I have been restless for so long,\nlonging to hold you to my chest.

arabic text: KOI MUJHE BATLAA TA NAHIN TERI NISHANI\nBARSAT ME TIRON KI\nKAHA DHOOND NE JAA-OON
english translation text: No one tells me any sign of where\nyou are. In this rain of arrows, where\nshall I go to search for you?

arabic text: BABA SE TERE TERA JANAZA NA UTHEGA\nRUKH JA ZARA ABBAS KO\nDARIYA SE BULAA-OON
english translation text: Your father cannot lift your funeral\nbier. Wait a little while—let me\ncall Abbas back from the river.

arabic text: YE KHOON BHARA KURTA YE MATTI ME BHARE BAAL\nSINE ME CHHUPA-ON KE\nMAI ANKHONSE LAGAA-OON
english translation text: This bloodstained shirt, these dust-covered locks—shall\nI hide them against my chest\nor press them to my eyes?

arabic text: ISS TARHA KOI RUTTH KE MAASE NAHIN JAATA\nTU KHUD HI BATAA DE ME\nTUJHE KAISE MANAA-OON
english translation text: No one leaves their mother in anger\nlike this. Tell me yourself: how\nshall I persuade you to return?

arabic text: RAIHAN KE NAWHE PE SADAA BAANO KI AAYI\nME ANKHONSE ASHKON KE\nSAMANDER KO BAHAAN-OON
english translation text: At Rehan’s lament, Banu’s cry arose:\n‘With the tears of my eyes,\nI will pour out an ocean.’
